term.title: supramolecular association

definitions.text: Self-assembly involving reversible, noncovalent, directional interactions of molecules that result in a high-molecular-mass entity.

notes.1: Use of the term "supramolecular polymerization" is discouraged.

sources: PAC, 2012, 85, 463. 'Terminology for aggregation and self-assembly in polymer science (IUPAC Recommendations 2013)' on page 488 (https://doi.org/10.1351/PAC-REC-12-03-12)
